tagline: A leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services and supply chain solutions for commercial, industrial, technology and utility customers.
hero_kpi_rationale: Organic growth of 8.6% reflects the company's solid intrinsic performance, driven by data center demand and infrastructure-related projects, without the impact of acquisitions or currency fluctuations.

kpis.name: Net revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Net revenue represents total sales for fiscal year 2025. Growth of 7.8% is a key performance indicator.
kpis.signal: Solid net revenue growth of 7.8%, reflecting robust performance in 2025.

kpis.name: Organic sales growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth adjusted for currency effects, acquisitions/divestitures and working days.
kpis.description: Organic sales growth measures sales increase without the impact of acquisitions, currency fluctuations or working day variations.
kpis.signal: Robust organic sales growth of 8.6%, indicating solid intrinsic performance beyond external impacts.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.description: Employee count is a key indicator of company size and operational capacity.
kpis.signal: Stable headcount of approximately 21,000 employees, indicating sound human resource management.

risks.title: Global economic risk
risks.score_rationale: Global economic conditions and disruptions in financial and commodity markets could negatively impact the company and its customers. This directly affects customer activity levels and product demand.

risks.title: Currency risk
risks.score_rationale: Currency exchange rate fluctuations could impact the company's financial results given international operations in approximately 50 countries.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to complex global laws and regulations. Failure to comply could have a material impact on the company.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risk
risks.score_rationale: Future acquisitions could present integration risks, value realization issues and uncertainties. WESCO pursues an acquisition strategy as a capital allocation priority.

risks.title: Competition and expansion risk
risks.score_rationale: Expansion into new markets could present regulatory and distribution challenges different from current operations, facing increased competition.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks with the implementation of a new Digital and Data Platform. Attacks on critical systems and data could disrupt operations.

risks.title: Reputation risk
risks.score_rationale: Any regulatory or operational failure could negatively impact the company's reputation with customers, suppliers and stakeholders.

ai_positioning.summary: WESCO recognizes AI and data centers as key secular trends. The company positions its data center distribution and infrastructure solutions activities as beneficiaries of AI trends. References include data centers, AI-driven growth, and rising demand for technology infrastructure.
evidence: CSS data center business primarily driving growth
Well positioned to benefit from enduring secular growth trends of AI-driven data centers
Increased infrastructure activity fueled by rising demand for data center projects
Network investments supporting broadband business growth
